chapter: Advanced Multi-Step Word Problems and Logical Reasoning

questions.question: Tom has 15 marbles. Jay has 7 more marbles than Tom. How many marbles do they have altogether?
A bus carried 36 passengers. At the first stop, 8 got off and 5 got on. At the second stop, 4 got off. How many passengers are on the bus now?
A box contains 48 cookies. They are shared equally among 6 children. How many cookies does each child get?
Ria has twice as many stickers as Sam. Sam has 9 stickers. How many stickers do they have together?
A rope is 95 cm long. First 25 cm is cut off. Then 18 cm is cut off. How much rope remains?
There are 8 baskets with 7 apples in each basket. 12 apples are eaten. How many apples remain?
Om has $30. He buys a toy for $12 and a book for $7. Then his grandmother gives him $10. How much money does he have now?
A classroom has 5 rows of desks with 6 desks in each row. 4 more desks are brought in. How many desks are there now?
If one notebook costs $4, how many notebooks can you buy with $28?
A train traveled 145 miles on Monday and 178 miles on Tuesday. It traveled 95 miles on Wednesday. How many miles did it travel altogether?
Jay has 3 fewer candies than Om. Together they have 21 candies. If Om has 12 candies, how many candies does Jay have?
A farmer has chickens and cows. There are 12 animals altogether. If 5 are cows, how many are chickens?
A number is greater than 30 but less than 40. It is also divisible by 5. What number could it be?
School starts at 8:20 AM and ends at 2:50 PM. How long is the school day?
I am thinking of a number. If you double it and then add 6, the answer is 20. What is my number?
